4423007102.descriptionHtml:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.



Job Description

About the team:

At Jitterbit, engineering is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in writing high-quality, maintainable code and delivering a world-class user experience. Our team is collaborative, driven, and embraces a remote-first culture designed for productivity and innovation.

You’ll work closely with engineers, product managers, and operations to push the boundaries of what’s possible in enterprise integration. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.

About the role:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing and developing new features for our iPaaS and APIM platform. You'll work with a modern and diverse tech stack, including:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java, C++, Lua
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Nginx, Tomcat, Apache
  • Data & Messaging: MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB
  • Cloud Services: AWS (S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB)

You’ll take ownership of projects from design through deployment, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in a 24x7x365 environment. This is a high-impact role offering the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and help shape the future of integration and automation.

About you:

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

  • Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer
  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture
  • Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives
  • Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers
  • Are able to make data driven decisions
  • Are a believer in a best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from

Qualifications

We are looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in building large scale distributed applications.
  • Strong experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with great attention to detail
  • Experience with Microservices and Cloud-based architectures/design patterns

Technical Skills and Experience:

  • Strong Experience in Java
  • Substantial experience with top tier RDBMS such as SQL Server and MySQL
  • Excellent JavaScript, CSS and HTML authoring skills.
  • Proficiency with Javascript, TypeScript, Java Node.js, or Go.
  • Familiar with application deployment via Docker and/or Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, S3, or CloudFront.

Additional Information

What You’ll Get:

  • Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
  • Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
  • Career development and mentorship
  • A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart



Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Precisely is the leader in data integrity. We empower businesses to make more confident decisions based on trusted data through a unique combination of software, data enrichment products and strategic services. What does this mean to you? For starters, it means joining a company focused on delivering outstanding innovation and support that helps customers increase revenue, lower costs and reduce risk. In fact, Precisely powers better decisions for more than 12,000 global organizations, including 95 of the Fortune 100. Precisely's 2500 employees are unified by four company core values that are central to who we are and how we operate: Openness, Determination, Individuality, and Collaboration. We are committed to career development for our employees and offer opportunities for growth, learning and building community. With a "work from anywhere" culture, we celebrate diversity in a distributed environment with a presence in 30 countries as well as 20 offices in over 5 continents. Learn more about why it's an exciting time to join Precisely!

Precisely is an AI-first organization. All employees are expected to demonstrate proficiency in applying AI tools to accelerate their work, improve output quality, and eliminate low-value tasks. Candidates should be comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) in their day-to-day workflows, able to evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, and open to continuously adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge.

 

Overview:

The role will be responsible for translating product strategy and business priorities into a coherent set of features for one or more scrum teams. Take on multiple roles including Feature lead, Developer, product designer, QA, and project manager. Key member of the team strategizing and presenting the future vision of the product to business and technology stakeholders in collaboration with the Product Manager.

What you will do:

  • Execute the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  • Helps conduct market and competitive analysis, defines products to serve those needs, the addressable market, ability to penetrate and sell, and overall business justification and strategic fit for products.
  • Help execute the value proposition and business case.
  • Provides team leadership through communication and coordination of cross functional teams at all levels of the organization.
  • Leads architecture for all components in an investment segment. May focus on one component but must have expertise across all components.
  • Responsible for design of systems in the investment segment.
  • Actively supports Product Manager in the Product Planning, business performance of one or more products.
  • Engage with customers throughout the product lifecycle to better glean product insights.
  • Understand requirements that comes from stakeholders and helps turn them into consumable backlog items for the team.
  • Write clear, compelling, and detailed (technical) user epics and stories with user acceptance criteria. Participate in story grooming exercises for crisp and unambiguous documentation and communication of features to be developed.
  • Ensure the backlog is prioritized in order before the sprint.
  • Coordinate with appropriate architects to ensure tech decisions are made and implemented. Also Identifying business process improvements and opportunities for automation.
  • Work with the Product Manager and Engineering Leader to propose percentage of effort for different types of value in each release.
  • Participates in technical and sales enablement.

What we are looking for:

  •  Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in business or technical field.
  •  8+ years of industry experience in the areas of data engineering and product management. 
  • Expertise in Java for backend development.
  • Expertise with databases, particularly Mongo Atlas, and developing/consuming REST APIs.
  • Track record of Designing and developing data products or software products.
  • Exposure to cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices architecture is a must. 
  • Basic understanding of agile and scrum methodologies is a must.  
  • Experience of AWS/Azure/GCP, Redis, Security Domain, Datadog, Code fresh
  • Working knowledge of data ETL will be preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI etc.
  • Ability to communicate with various stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and active listener.
  • Able to set and meet time-sensitive goals.
  • Able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to change while providing structure to operations and go-to-market teams.

AI Skills/Knowledge:

  • AI-assisted development: Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to support coding, code review, documentation, and test generation.
  • LLM and agentic workflows: Familiarity with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, with the ability to apply them thoughtfully in software engineering use cases.
  • Responsible AI practices: Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, security considerations, explainability, and appropriate use of AI-generated outputs.

Preferred Skills (a plus but not required):

  • Familiarity with frontend scripting languages such as Node.js and React.js
  • Understanding of spark framework along with Snowflake and Databricks.
  • Hands on Terraform will be advantageous.

The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

4448096412.descriptionHtml:
The Team


Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management, and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive, and machine learning.


Your Work Profile


The Senior Java AWS Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining cloud-native applications for the Energy sector using Java, Spring Boot, and AWS technologies. The role involves building scalable, secure, and high-performing microservices, leveraging modern DevOps practices, and ensuring code quality through automated testing and governance frameworks. The candidate will collaborate with architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions that support digital transformation initiatives.


Key Skills Required

•5–10 years of professional software development experience.

•Strong expertise in Java (up to Java 25) and Spring Boot framework.•Mandatory hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development.

•Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices-based applications.

•Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software architecture principles.

•Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.

•Hands-on experience with SonarQube for code quality, security analysis, and technical debt management.

•Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

•Strong understanding of cloud security, scalability, monitoring, and performance optimization.

•Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

•Strong verbal and written communication skills.

•Ability to work effectively within Agile and cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications

•Education - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

•Experience working within the Energy, Utilities, Sustainability, or Smart Infrastructure domain.

•Knowledge of event-driven architectures and messaging frameworks.•Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

•Exposure to AWS serverless technologies and managed services.

•Relevant AWS or Java certifications are preferred.

•Experience working in large-scale enterprise environments.


Key Skills & Competencies

•Java Development•Spring Boot

•AWS Cloud Services

•Microservices Architecture

•REST API Development

•Docker Containerization

•Kubernetes Orchestration

•SonarQube & Code Quality Governance

•CI/CD & DevOps Practices

•Cloud-Native Application Development

•Performance Optimization

•Security Best Practices

•Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking

•Agile Development

•Stakeholder Collaboration


Success Metrics•Delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud-native applications.

•Successful implementation of AWS-based solutions aligned with business requirements.

•High code quality standards maintained through SonarQube and engineering best practices.

•Reduced deployment time through efficient CI/CD automation.

•Improved system reliability, availability, and scalability.

•Timely resolution of technical challenges and production issues.

•Positive stakeholder feedback and successful project delivery outcomes.

•Contribution to innovation and modernization initiatives within the Energy domain.


Location and Way of Working

•Base Location: Bengaluru

•Working Model: Hybrid working model based on business and project requirements.

  • Systems Integration: Collaborate with DevOps, Technical Leads, Solutions Architects, and Enterprise Architects to ensure seamless e-commerce integration across a complex ecosystem.


  • Architecture Modernization: Support new architectural visions (such as headless commerce and decoupled frontends) and actively help migrate legacy or custom components into modern architectural patterns.


Skills & Abilities



  • Core Technical Stack: Proven project experience utilizing React, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js , alongside REST API development .


  • E-Commerce Platform Expertise: Strong development experience with SAP Hybris (SAP Commerce Cloud) Or BigCommerce platform ecosystems.

4424676269.descriptionHtml:
Summary

 Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages  cutting-edge  engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and  operate  integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms,  driving  innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements.  You’ll  work alongside talented  professionals  reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Position Summary

Level: Software Engineer II

As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver backend and front-end engineering solutions that support enterprise-scale applications and client transformations. You will apply experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Angular to build maintainable, secure, and scalable solutions while contributing to delivery quality, process improvement, and innovation. This role offers the opportunity to work across modern engineering practices, strengthen technical depth, and support high-quality outcomes in a collaborative environment.

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
  • Building and enhancing Angular applications using TypeScript, reactive programming patterns, and integration with RESTful services
  • Supporting solution design decisions by evaluating technical approaches, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, maintainable, and performant implementations
  • Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
  • Contributing to process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes

The Team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST

Qualifications

Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

  • Core JAVA & Backend engineering
  • 4 - 7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
  • Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
  • Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
  • Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
  • Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
  • Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
  • Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
  • Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
  • Angular
  • 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Angular
  • Strong hands-on experience building scalable and production-grade angular applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Strong understanding of Angular fundamentals, including components , modules , services , dependency injection (DI) , routing , guards, and forms (template / reactive - driven).
  • Proficiency with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables , operators , subscription management and effective error handling patterns.
  • Experience implementing state management patterns ( e.g. , NgRx or equivalent), including separation of UI state vs domain state
  • Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross-browser compatibility
  • Hands-on experience integrating Angular applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including interceptors, route guards, and role-based UI behavior.
  • Strong testing & Debugging skills with unit tests (Jasmine/Karma/Jest) and end-to-end automation (Playwright/Cypress), ensuring stability and maintainability.
  • Experience with Angular performance optimization, including lazy loading, change detection strategies, efficient rendering, and bundle optimization
  • Familiarity with Angular CLI, environment configuration, build pipelines, and deployment optimization
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
  • Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
  • Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

  • Certification (JAVA):
  • Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
  • Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Agile Development and Collaboration
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
  • Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
  • Awareness of any of the industry domains

Java Full Stack Software Engineer

Experience: 2–4 Years

Role Summary

We are looking for a passionate Java Full Stack Software Engineer to join our product engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications and backend services while working closely with your team to deliver high-quality product features.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Java and React.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs.
  • Build responsive and reusable frontend components.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain application databases.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following software engineering best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, debugging, performance optimization, and production issue resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, QA engineers, and product stakeholders within the team.
  • Write unit and integration tests to ensure code quality.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and environment configurations.
  • Follow Agile/Scrum development practices and actively participate in sprint activities.


Required Skills

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience in Java Full Stack application development.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and the Spring ecosystem for building enterprise applications and REST APIs.
  • Experience with React.js, TypeScript, HTML5, and any modern CSS framework.
  • Good understanding of relational databases, SQL, and database design principles.
  • Experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with Spring Security and authentication/authorization mechanisms such as JWT or OAuth2.
  • Good understanding of Microservices architecture and experience developing or working with microservices-based applications.
  • Experience with Git, Maven/Gradle, Postman, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in the Healthcare/MedTech domain, especially with PACS (Picture Archiving and Communication System) based applications, is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Exposure to Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.


Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.


Ideal Candidate

A self-driven engineer who enjoys building scalable products, can independently deliver features end-to-end, write high-quality code, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute effectively as part of a product engineering team.

4460325336.descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As a Java Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications across the full software development lifecycle. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions while leveraging modern Java technologies, cloud platforms, and front-end frameworks.

You will contribute to application architecture, backend services, user interface development, system integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure robust and high-performing digital solutions.

In This Role You Will Play a Key Role In:

  • Designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end web applications using Java and modern front-end technologies.
  • Building scalable microservices and RESTful APIs to support enterprise-grade applications.
  • Collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, product owners, and development teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Developing responsive and interactive user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Integrating applications with databases, third-party systems, and cloud services.
  • Writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following coding standards and best practices.
  • Performing code reviews, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing application performance.
  • Participating in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release activities.
  • Implementing automated unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure application quality.
  • Supporting CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for streamlined application deployment.
  • Ensuring application security, compliance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Mentoring junior developers and contributing to technical excellence within the team.

Your Profile

Top 5 Technical Skills

  • Java 8/11/17 & Spring Boot
    • Strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA.
    • Experience building scalable microservices and REST APIs.
  • React.js / Angular
    • Hands-on experience developing responsive user interfaces using modern front-end frameworks.
    • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and UI design principles.
  • Microservices & API Development
    • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, service orchestration, and distributed systems.
    • Familiarity with API gateways and event-driven architecture.
  • Cloud & DevOps
    • Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud platforms.
    • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
  • Database Technologies
    • Strong experience with SQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL databases like MongoDB.
    • Expertise in data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning.

4446791357.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Java Developer with 5+ years' experience to build high-performing, scalable enterprise portal backends, APIs, and modern React frontends. You'll develop modular services, cloud-native integrations, and headless APIs for robust, production-ready portal applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop modular Java backend services (OSGi modules, Service Builder equivalents) and RESTful/GraphQL headless APIs for enterprise portals.
  • Build responsive React frontends with client extensions consuming portal APIs and state management (Redux/Zustand).
  • Design and optimize Postgres/MySQL databases with advanced entity-service mappings and SQL performance tuning.
  • Implement event-driven integrations using message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus) for cross-module communication.
  • Deploy containerized portal applications with Docker/Kubernetes on Azure, ensuring high availability.
  • Optimize performance with distributed caching (Redis, Hazelcast), low-latency APIs, and frontend bundle optimization.
  • Collaborate across full SDLC: API contracts, modular development, frontend integration, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Implement full-stack observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog across backend services and frontend.
  • Implement DevSecOps with automated security scanning, CI/CD pipelines for modular deployments.

Must-Have Skills

  • Backend/Portal: Java 17+, Spring Boot, enterprise portal frameworks (OSGi modules, Service Builder, modular service layers); REST/GraphQL headless APIs.
  • Frontend: React 18+, TypeScript, hooks, component libraries (Material-UI), portal client extensions/API integration.
  • Architecture: Microservices/modular monoliths, design patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, repository patterns).
  • Agentic Coding: Proficiency with agentic AI coding assistants for rapid prototyping, refactoring complex OSGi modules, and generating tests across full-stack components.
  • DevOps/CI-CD: Docker, Kubernetes (Helm charts), Jenkins/GitHub Actions, multi-module pipelines.
  • Cloud: Azure (2+ years hands-on).
  • Databases: Postgres/MySQL, JPA/Hibernate, advanced SQL, entity-service mappings.
  • Testing: JUnit/Mockito (backend), Jest/React Testing Library (frontend), integration testing.
  • Tools: Git, Gradle/Maven (multi-module), npm/yarn.
  • Full SDLC experience; OWASP security for enterprise applications.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Kafka streaming, Next.js for portal frontends.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform for portal deployments).
  • Advanced monitoring: Datadog, Splunk.
  • Domain-Driven Design, legacy system integration (.NET/mainframes).
  • Portal-specific patterns: content management, user personalization, workflow engines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's/Master’s in computer science.
  • Cloud/Java certifications.

4458741493.descriptionHtml:
Business Overview

BNP Paribas is a leading global banking group with a strong diversified and integrated model. We provide a wide range of financial services to individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates, and institutional clients. Our technology teams are at the heart of our digital transformation, building robust, scalable, and secure applications that power international banking operations and enhance client experiences across the globe.


Position Purpose

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Backend Developer - Java to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining end-to-end software solutions. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality code that aligns with the Group’s architecture guidelines and business objectives.


Job Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable backend applications using Java with a deep understanding of Core Java concepts (Collections, Multithreading, Streams API).
  • Translate functional requirements and business needs into detailed technical specifications and architecture designs.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Perform unit testing, integration testing, and participate in peer code reviews to ensure high standards of quality.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance bottlenecks in production and non-production environments.
  • Actively participate in all Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Retrospectives) and collaborate closely with Business Analysts and Product Owners.
  • Execute (CI/CD) continuous integration and deployment pipelines to ensure a smooth delivery calendar.
  • Stay updated with emerging technology trends and propose improvements to existing systems to enhance scalability and robustness.


Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Engineering, or a related field with 6+ years applied experience
  • Strong proficiency in Java (Version 11 or higher) with a deep understanding of Core Java concepts (Collections, Multithreading, Streams API).
  • Extensive experience with the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security) and Hibernate.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases.
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
  • Extensive experience with Jenkins, Ansible, or other CI/CD automation tools.


Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Angular or React).
  • Knowledge in designing and implementing Microservices architecture.
  • Exposure to event-driven architecture and messaging tools such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Prior experience working within the Banking or Financial Services industry.
  • Strong teamwork skills and the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

Job Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior MuleSoft Developer with 4-8 years of IT experience and strong expertise in designing, developing, and implementing integration solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building APIs, system integrations, application connectivity solutions, and cloud-based integrations while following API-led connectivity principles and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain MuleSoft integration solutions using Mule 4.
  • Build reusable APIs, connectors, and integration services using Anypoint Platform.
  • Implement API-led connectivity architecture including Experience, Process, and System APIs.
  • Develop integrations between cloud and on-premise applications.
  • Create RAML/OpenAPI specifications and API documentation.
  • Configure and manage Anypoint Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager, and CloudHub.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize Mule applications.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Implement security standards including OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, TLS, and API policies.
  • Work closely with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver integration solutions.
  • Ensure adherence to SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
  • Support production deployments, incident management, and root cause analysis.

Required Skills

MuleSoft Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Experience in Mule 4 development.
  • Knowledge of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with DataWeave 2.0 transformations.
  • Expertise in RESTful APIs, SOAP Web Services, and integration patterns.
  • Experience with API lifecycle management.

Integration & Middleware

  • Enterprise application integration (EAI).
  • Message Queues and asynchronous integrations.
  • Batch processing and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience integrating ERP, CRM, and SaaS applications.

Cloud & DevOps

  • Experience with CloudHub and Runtime Fabric.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab.
  • Experience with Git, Maven, and deployment automation.

Database & Messaging

  • SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Messaging platforms such as JMS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.

Security

  • OAuth 2.0
  • OpenID Connect
  • JWT
  • SSL/TLS
  • API Security Best Practices

Required Qualifications

Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Salesforce MuleSoft Lead Developer with 6-10 years of IT experience, including strong expertise in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Salesforce integration, API-led connectivity, and enterprise application integration. The ideal candidate will lead the design, development, implementation, and support of integration solutions, ensuring scalable and secure APIs while collaborating with business and technology stakeholders.

The candidate should possess strong technical leadership capabilities, hands-on development expertise, and experience delivering integration solutions in Agile environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Lead end-to-end integration projects involving Salesforce CRM and other enterprise applications.
  • Develop and maintain APIs using MuleSoft's API-led connectivity approach.
  • Design reusable integration frameworks, templates, and common services.
  • Implement RESTful and SOAP web services, microservices, and event-driven integrations.
  • Collaborate with architects, business analysts, and product owners to understand integration requirements.
  • Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Lead troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support activities.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers and integration engineers.
  • Manage deployments through CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Ensure API security, governance, monitoring, and compliance standards are met.
  • Participate in solution design discussions and contribute to enterprise integration strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 6-10 years of overall IT experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Strong experience in: Mule 4 Anypoint Studio API Manager Runtime Manager Exchange DataWeave 2.0 CloudHub / CloudHub 2.0
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with: SAP Oracle Workday ServiceNow Banking/ERP applications Third-party systems
  • Strong understanding of: REST APIs SOAP Web Services JSON XML RAML OpenAPI Specifications
  • Experience with Salesforce technologies: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Salesforce APIs Platform Events Bulk API Streaming API
  • Knowledge of messaging technologies: Kafka JMS MQ Event-driven architectures
  • Experience with databases: SQL Server Oracle MySQL PostgreSQL
  • Hands-on experience with: Git Jenkins Azure DevOps GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines

Leadership Skills

  • Experience leading and coordinating development teams.
  • Ability to drive technical discussions and solution reviews.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience estimating effort and planning project deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MuleSoft Certified Developer (MCD - Level 1/2).
  • MuleSoft Platform Architect Certification.
  • Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce Platform Developer Certification.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of integration patterns, enterprise architecture, and security best practices.

Key Competencies

  • API Design & Development
  • Enterprise Integration
  • Salesforce Integration
  • Technical Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Performance Optimization
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Agile Delivery
  • Team Mentoring

Compensation

Estimated Pay Range:

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

4456711096.descriptionHtml:
About Delivery Hero India:


Delivery Hero India is part of Delivery Hero Group, the world’s leading local delivery platform. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide, powered by tech but driven by people. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.


Job Descriptions:


  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot framework.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver scalable and efficient backend solutions.
  • Implement and manage databases, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Develop RESTful APIs to support various front-end and mobile applications.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of applications.
  • Conduct code reviews, write unit tests, and maintain documentation for backend services.
  • Troubleshoot and debug applications to optimize performance.
  • Participate in agile development processes and contribute to team improvements.
  • Work closely with product managers and other developers towards the completion of development assigned features.
  • Continuously find ways to improve and optimize the architecture, code, and processes of our Backend applications.
  • The Employee, as per business needs, may be required to undertake any other such duties as may be assigned in line with the employee’s position, skills, and capabilities.


The Employee, as per business needs, may be required to undertake any other such duties as may be assigned in line with the employee’s position, skills, and capabilities.


Requirements:


  • Minimum 2 years of working experience in a similar role
  • Good knowledge of design patterns, asynchronous data flows, event driven systems
  • Experience designing and building high availability, high scalability RESTFul APIs
  • Ability to investigate critical issues of the system, and to propose and implement the solution
  • Great team player, also have the ability to work independently with minimum supervision
  • Must be proficient in English (written and spoken)
  • Experience in development best practices including Agile development, peer code reviews, and unit testing
  • Able to communicate clearly, especially in speaking. We have an environment where team members will work remotely.


Experience / Knowledge in the following area would be a plus point:


  • Mobile payments / m-Commerce
  • Commerce-based applications such as ERP, Accounting, Point of Sale, e-Commerce, Loyalty & Redemption systems, etc.


Desired Tech Stack:


  • Java: Proficiency in Java programming, with a strong understanding of object-oriented principles.
  • Spring Boot: Extensive experience with the Spring Boot framework for building microservices and web applications.
  • Databases: Experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
  • Hibernate/JPA: Knowledge of Hibernate ORM and Java Persistence API for database interaction.
  • Develop and optimize RESTful APIs with proper versioning, validation, and error handling; document APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth 2.0 and JWT.
  • Manage relational data using MySQL and ECMS databases, ensuring data integrity, optimized queries, and schema design.
  • Integrate caching, messaging, and search capabilities using Redis, Pub/Sub, and Elasticsearch for performance and scalability.
  • Design and deploy cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging Cloud Functions and Google Cloud Storage.
  • Monitor application health, performance, and logs using Grafana, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end features, perform code reviews, and enforce coding standards.
  • Ensure security, scalability, and maintainability across the application lifecycle.
  • Security: Understanding security principles and practices, including OAuth2 and JWT.
  • Testing: Proficiency in writing unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito, or similar frameworks.
  • Version Control: Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Build Tools: Familiarity with build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
  • Containerization: Knowledge of containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes is advantageous.


Nice to Have:


  • Experience with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Contribution to open-source projects or active participation in developer communities.
  • Having worked on large-scale event-driven applications

Just be yourself and we can’t wait to see what value you bring to the role. We're as interested in your character as we are in your talent.

About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a backend focus, building services in Java and Spring Boot alongside an Angular frontend. This person is comfortable moving database-centric designs toward domain-driven structures and building RESTful APIs with clean, modern patterns. Strong SQL and relational database skills are essential.


What you will do

  • Spend the majority of your time (approx. 70-80%) designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain the supporting Angular frontend, ensuring a seamless connection between the UI and your backend logic.
  • Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a domain-driven structure (DDD).
  • Architect RESTful APIs that prioritize proper HTTP verbs and clean, scalable patterns over legacy RPC styles.
  • Work within cross-functional squads to deliver high-quality features while maintaining the "cohesive and proactive" spirit of the team.


Must haves

4454440868.descriptionHtml:
Backend Java Engineer (Java, Springboot & Kafka)

Engagement (Support-heavy, 70% Support and 30% Development)

Shift Timings: Morning Shift (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM) and Afternoon Shift (3:00 PM to 12:00 AM)

Years of Experience - 4 to 7 years (Mid Level)

Roles Open - 2 in the morning shift and 2 in the afternoon shift

Employment: Full-time employment with Samay India

Location: Remote (India)

On-call: Participation in a shared on-call rotation is required.

Availability: Preferring candidates who can join within 30 days or less.


Job Description


We are looking for hands-on Java backend engineers to join our Sustainment & Enhancement Squad. This role focuses on supporting, maintaining, and enhancing integrations with Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS.


The ideal candidate will have a strong development background along with production support experience. You should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across multiple services, identifying root causes, implementing permanent fixes, and working with senior engineers when issues require further escalation.


This role is suited to someone who understands how backend services communicate across systems and can effectively debug production issues while contributing to ongoing development and system improvements.


What You Will Do


- Develop a good understanding of Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS, its APIs, integration points, and the upstream and downstream services that interact with it.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and support integrations with Oracle Retail Cloud MFCS and related backend services.

- Analyze application logs, database queries, API responses, Kafka events, and other system information to identify and resolve production issues.

- Troubleshoot issues across multiple services and identify whether the problem originates within the application, the database, the integration layer, or an external downstream system.

- Participate in production incident resolution, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurring issues.

- Maintain and enhance existing Java and Spring Boot applications, including bug fixes, minor enhancements, and performance improvements.

- Develop and maintain unit and integration tests and contribute to testing strategies that help identify issues before they reach production.

- Follow and contribute to coding standards, code review practices, monitoring, documentation, and other engineering best practices.

- Work closely with L3 and Lead engineers and other teams when issues require deeper technical investigation or architectural changes.

- Participate in on-call support and ensure production issues are communicated, tracked and escalated appropriately.


What You Will Bring


- 4 to 6 years of experience in Java backend development and production support.

- Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.

- Strong hands-on production experience with Kafka, including real-time streaming and event-driven flows.

- Good understanding of REST APIs, service-to-service communication, and distributed backend systems.

- Strong SQL and relational database knowledge.

- Experience debugging and resolving production issues in backend applications.

- Good understanding of application logs, monitoring, debugging, and root cause analysis.

- Good understanding of integration patterns and troubleshooting issues across multiple services.

- Good understanding of unit testing and integration testing practices.

- Ability to work independently on L2 issues while knowing when and how to escalate complex issues.

- Willingness to participate in a shared on-call rotation.

- Understanding of cloud platforms and DevOps practices is good to have.


What Sets This Role Apart


We are looking for someone who has the fire and zeal to learn and deliver more, someone who is not limited to resolving tickets, but is able and interested to understand why an issue occurred and how to prevent it from happening again.
